headline: SFG @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 4.56 at ATL 4.41, with a projected total of 8.97. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SFG: SFG moved +0.51 runs while ATL moved +0.10, changing the projected margin by +0.40 runs. The projected total climbed +0.65, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +7.6%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: JR Ritchie has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Luis Arraez, Bryce Eldridge, Jung Hoo Lee, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Willy Adames, Austin Riley because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
